task_instance: Point the cohere-deploy-integration skill at a small realistic Cohere-powered Node/Express SSE chat service (repository-path=./sample-repo, platform=cloud-run, environment=staging) and produce the deployment-readiness handoff the skill's Output section defines: resolved API/model contract, files inspected, evidence, validation result in the compact handoff shape, remaining risk, owner, and next action.
evidence: Created sample-repo (package.json, src/server.js, public/app.js, deploy/service.yaml, .env.example) with realistic deploy defects. Ran the skill's read-only inspection (grep/find over the tree): found a provider key hardcoded in the browser bundle public/app.js:3 (Error-table 'Key in client bundle'), the key inlined in deploy/service.yaml:20 instead of a secret manager, response-buffering=true and timeoutSeconds=15 on the Cloud Run service (buffered-stream condition), containerConcurrency=0, and an unprotected billable /readyz provider probe at src/server.js:14 versus a correct local /healthz. Mapped every finding to the skill's Current Contract and Error Handling table and wrote the deliverable handoff.md (55 lines) in the compact shape: secrets=FAIL, stream=FAIL, provider-probe=FAIL, health-check=PASS, model-contract=PARTIAL, plus resolved contract, files inspected, evidence, risk, owner and next actions. Deliverable verified by re-reading handoff.md and confirming each line is backed by a grep hit. The skill's allowed tools are Read/Glob/Grep/WebFetch/Write/Edit (no execution tools), so its core deliverable is this read-only readiness handoff, which exists and is verified. Live canary/rollback execution is marked NOT-VERIFIED in the handoff: the skill itself gates that as owner-approved and it would require an account-bound Cohere key, network access and a public cloud deploy, which are out of scope for the read-only diagnosis and forbidden by the safety rules. Files produced: sample-repo/, handoff.md, result.json in the work directory. Note: no live Cohere model call was made.
